text:
## Policy Review & Updates  
**Review Frequency:** Annual (or upon emerging fraud type)
**Last Review:** 2026-01-15
**Next Review:** 2027-01-15  
---
name: Chunk 31/32

raw_entities.name: Fraud Policy Review and Update Framework
raw_entities.description: A policy framework governing the periodic review and update of fraud-related policies and procedures. The policy establishes an annual review cycle with provisions for ad-hoc reviews triggered by the emergence of new fraud types or threats.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon emerging fraud type)

raw_entities.name: Annual Policy Review Requirement
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to conduct a comprehensive review of fraud policies on an annual basis. The review cycle is fixed at 12-month intervals unless triggered earlier by the emergence of new fraud types.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon emerging fraud type)

raw_entities.name: Triggered Policy Review Upon Emerging Fraud Type
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring an immediate or expedited policy review when new or previously unaddressed fraud types emerge. This allows the policy framework to remain responsive to evolving fraud threats beyond the standard annual cycle.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon emerging fraud type)

raw_entities.name: Emerging Fraud Type
raw_entities.description: A newly identified or previously unaddressed category of fraudulent activity or threat that may warrant immediate policy review and control updates. The emergence of such fraud types serves as a trigger for out-of-cycle policy review.
context: Review Frequency: Annual (or upon emerging fraud type)
